converter-steps.file: Drop one or more .mid files on the converter, or choose them. Nothing is uploaded.
converter-steps.engines: Pick FROM, the engine your file was written for, and TO, the engine you play.
converter-steps.convert: Press Convert, then download the file, or one .zip for several. The report lists every note that moved to a close match.

list: Hover dotted text to see what changed; the note editor fixes any drum.
Save a preset to reuse your setup. Presets stay in this browser; export one (.json) and drop it on the page to use it elsewhere.

faq.q: How do I convert GetGood Drums MIDI to EZdrummer?
a: Add the .mid, set the source to GetGood Drums and the target to EZdrummer, then download the remapped file.

faq.q: Can I convert multiple files at once?
a: Yes. Queue several .mid files and download them all as a single .zip.
